Codex warns when `features.multi_agent` is explicitly configured and points to `agents.enabled` for disabling subagent tools. (#59479)

title.zh-TW: Vertex AI 工具更新預設改為增量傳送
title.en: Vertex AI tool updates are now sent incrementally by default

body.zh-TW:
當你在 Google Cloud 透過 Vertex AI 讓 Codex 串接工具作業時，現在只會同步有變動的部分，不必每次重新傳遞整份清單。⟦就像辦公室登記下午茶訂單，以前有人加點，就得把整張菜單重抄一遍；現在只要回報新增的品項，而且還可以設定關掉，換回原本的做法。⟧如果不想用增量傳送，就打開設定檔 `config.toml`，在 `[features]` 區塊下加入這一行：

```toml
[features]
incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false
```

如果不想用增量傳送，在 `config.toml` 的 `[features]` 下加入 `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false` 即可關閉。
body.en:
When you connect Codex with tools through Vertex AI on Google Cloud, it now synchronizes only the parts that changed instead of resending the entire list each time. ⟦Picture taking afternoon tea orders in an office: previously, whenever someone added an item, you had to recopy the entire menu; now you only report the newly added items, and you can also configure it off to revert to the original method.⟧ If you do not want to use incremental sending, open the configuration file `config.toml` and add this line under the `[features]` section:

```toml
[features]
incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false
```

If you do not want to use incremental sending, you can turn it off by adding `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false` under `[features]` in `config.toml`.

items.original: Codex now sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI. To opt out, set `incremental_tools_legacy_gcp = false` under `[features]` in `config.toml`. ([#60617](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/60617), [#60848](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/60848))

title.zh-TW: 代理人指揮中心標記未讀結果，切換後端工作階段保留草稿
title.en: Agent command center marks unread results, and switching backend sessions preserves drafts

body.zh-TW: 平時如果習慣讓多個助理分頭調查專案，終端機現在能讓你清楚掌握每位幫手的最新進度。執行 `codex agents --no-daemon` 就能打開代理人指揮中心，指揮中心與終端機工作階段（session，正在進行中的對話作業）選取器現在都會主動標記出未讀的執行結果。⟦猶如總機櫃台的分機信箱，信件送達時格子會亮起提示燈，即使轉身前往另一張辦公桌交涉，手中寫到一半的便箋也不會遺失。⟧當你在工作階段選取器中切換不同的已連線後端時，輸入框中還沒送出的草稿會完整保留下來，不會因為更換後端就遭到清空。
body.en: If you regularly have several assistants investigate different parts of a project, the terminal now makes it easier to keep track of each helper’s latest progress. Run `codex agents --no-daemon` to open the agent command center. Both the command center and the terminal session picker (for ongoing conversations) now mark unread results. ⟦Like extension mailboxes at a switchboard desk, a compartment lights up when mail arrives, and even if you turn to another desk to discuss something, the note you are halfway through writing stays with you.⟧ When you switch between connected backends in the session picker, any unsent draft in the input box stays intact instead of being cleared.

items.original:
Open the agent command center with `codex agents --no-daemon`. The command center and session picker now mark unread results (#58238, #58239, #58263, #58264).
Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching (#58280, #58457).

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入框即時預覽附加圖片，逐字稿路徑支援點擊開啟
title.en: Preview attached images in the terminal input box and click transcript paths to open them

body.zh-TW: 在終端機請模型排查版面外觀或分析架構圖時，最怕挑錯要送出的圖檔。現在只要使用支援的終端機，在輸入框撰寫內容時就能直接預覽附加的本機圖片。⟦彷彿在公文夾附上拍立得縮圖，夾上檔案的當下就能先瞄一眼畫面確認無誤，事後查閱歸檔清單時也能隨手按壓標籤快速調閱原圖。⟧而在對話逐字稿（transcript，記錄完整互動內容的文字檔）中，顯示的本機圖片路徑現在也支援點擊，輕點路徑就能直接開啟剛剛檢視過的圖片。
body.en: When asking a model in the terminal to troubleshoot a layout or analyze an architecture diagram, choosing the wrong image to send is a particular concern. On supported terminals, you can now preview attached local images directly while composing in the input box. ⟦Picture attaching a Polaroid thumbnail to a document folder: you can glance at the image as soon as you attach the file to check that it is right, then press its label while reviewing the archive list later to quickly retrieve the original image.⟧ Local image paths shown in the conversation transcript (a text file recording the full interaction) are now clickable too. Click a path to open the image you just viewed.

items.original: Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths (#58261, #58446).

title.zh-TW: 登入選單支援 Vertex AI 設定精靈，切換模型提供者仍可查閱舊紀錄
title.en: Sign-in menu supports a Vertex AI setup wizard, and old chats remain accessible after switching providers

body.zh-TW: 需要連線到不同雲端平台調用模型時，設定登入與管理既有紀錄往往讓人傷腦筋。在「以其他方式登入（Sign in another way）」選單中，可以找到 API 金鑰與雲端提供者選項。只要啟用 `gcp_setup_wizard` 設定項，就能透過引導精靈以應用程式預設憑證（ADC，Google Cloud 用來自動驗證身分的機制）或憑證檔，串接 Google Cloud Vertex AI。⟦如同聘請不同事務所的顧問，櫃台提供制式表單幫你快速登記授權，而先前與上一家顧問往來的會議備忘錄依舊留在手邊，就算無法直接續約也能抄錄結論另開新專案。⟧切換模型提供者後，先前儲存的聊天紀錄依然會留在清單中。如果舊對話無法直接繼續執行，你也可以隨時閱讀歷史逐字稿，並把重點整理成可編輯的提示詞，在全新聊天中直接接續工作。
body.en: When connecting to different cloud platforms to use models, setting up sign-in and managing existing records can be a headache. You can find API key and cloud provider options under the “Sign in another way” menu. Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to connect to Google Cloud Vertex AI through a guided wizard using Application Default Credentials (Google Cloud’s mechanism for automatically authenticating your identity) or a credential file. ⟦Think of hiring consultants from different firms: the front desk supplies standard forms to quickly register your authorization, while meeting notes from your previous consultants remain at hand, so even if you cannot renew the engagement directly, you can copy the conclusions into a new project.⟧ After you switch model providers, previously saved chats remain in the list. If an old conversation cannot resume directly, you can still read its historical transcript and turn the key points into an editable prompt to continue working in a new chat.

items.original:
Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file (#57857, #58427).
Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat (#58202).

title.zh-TW: 審批提示下可展開修補細節，清螢幕保留紀錄且退格不跳指令模式
title.en: Expand patch details during approval, clear the screen while keeping history, and backspace without entering command mode

body.zh-TW:
在終端機審查程式碼修改並輸入回應時，細節檢視與打字體驗迎來了一批順手改進。

跳出審批提示（approval prompt）時，你現在能直接在對話逐字稿中展開修補程式細節。

在終端機整理畫面時，按下 `Ctrl+L` 會清空螢幕顯示內容，先前的對話訊息依然隨時能透過 `Ctrl+T` 叫出查閱。

在輸入框退格刪除文字時，就算露出開頭的驚嘆號 `!`，草稿依然會維持一般對話模式，不再被誤觸成執行外部指令的模式。
body.en:
Reviewing code changes and typing responses in the terminal now comes with several improvements to detail viewing and typing.

While an approval prompt is open, you can now expand patch details directly in the conversation transcript.

When tidying up the terminal view, pressing `Ctrl+L` clears the screen display. Earlier conversation messages remain available through `Ctrl+T` whenever you want to review them.

When backspacing in the input box exposes a leading exclamation mark `!`, the draft stays in ordinary chat mode instead of accidentally switching to the mode for running external commands.

items.original:
Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open (#58281).
`Ctrl+L` clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through `Ctrl+T` (#58266).
Deleting text that exposes a leading `!` keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode (#58412).

title.zh-TW: 支援系統網路代理設定，網路請求逐一排隊審批並明定權限規範
title.en: System proxy settings supported, network approvals queued individually, and permission rules documented

body.zh-TW:
在需要透過特定通道連線或對外部請求有嚴密資安管制的環境中，網路連線行為現在更容易掌握。

現在輸入 `/experimental` 就能選擇加入 macOS 或 Windows 的系統代理伺服器（proxy，協助轉發網路封包的中繼伺服器）設定，讓工具連線直接遵循作業系統的網路轉發規則。

遇到需要手動核准的網路連線時，網路審批提示會在請求結束時自動關閉。多個連往同一個端點的並行請求也不會再同時跳出干擾，而是依序逐一跳出提示讓你確認。

應用程式伺服器（app-server）的說明文件中，也正式補齊了設定檔 `[permissions.network]` 底下的受控網路限制說明，並明列了哪些 `prompt-user` 指令規則必須取得最新的人工審批才能放行。
body.en:
In environments that require connections through specific channels or tightly control external requests for security, network connection behavior is now easier to keep track of.

Enter `/experimental` to opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings (relay servers that help forward network packets), so tool connections directly follow the operating system’s network forwarding rules.

For network connections that require manual approval, the network approval prompt now closes automatically when the request ends. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint no longer interrupt you with simultaneous prompts. Instead, prompts appear one at a time for you to confirm.

The app-server (application server) documentation now also covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` in the configuration file and explicitly lists which `prompt-user` command rules require fresh human approval before they can proceed.

items.original:
Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from `/experimental` (#58157).
Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time (#58350, #58351).
The app-server README covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` and `prompt-user` command rules that require fresh human approval (#58045, #58182).

title.zh-TW: Realtime V3 語音自動存入對話歷史，上下文壓縮納入失敗回應產出
title.en: Realtime V3 speech saves automatically to chat history, and context compaction counts output from failed responses

body.zh-TW: 當你進行長時間的即時對話或複雜的多輪問答時，對話內容的完整記錄與記憶管理至關重要。在長期的 Realtime V3 即時語音對話中，隨著逐字稿長度增長，工具會即時將已結束的語音內容保存至聊天歷史記錄中。⟦好比速記員一邊開會一邊將說完的發言謄進議事錄，管帳人員在打包過長卷宗時，也會把印壞的草稿和漏蓋計費章的廢頁通通算入紙張重量。⟧在對話長度過長觸發自動上下文壓縮時，計算機制現在也會如實算入執行失敗回應留下的輸出，以及缺少 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量數據的回應。
body.en: When you have long real-time conversations or complex exchanges with multiple rounds of questions and answers, complete conversation records and memory management are essential. During long Realtime V3 voice conversations, the tool saves completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows. ⟦Imagine a stenographer transcribing completed remarks into the minutes as a meeting proceeds, while the bookkeeper packing up overly long files counts misprinted drafts and discarded pages missing billing stamps toward the total paper weight.⟧ When a conversation gets long enough to trigger automatic context compaction, the calculation now also counts retained output from failed responses and responses missing token usage data (the text units AI processes and bills for).

items.original:
Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows (#58221).
Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data (#58404).

title.zh-TW: 淘汰模型主動推薦替代方案，Linux musl 降低閒置記憶體佔用
title.en: Retiring models get replacement recommendations, and Linux musl reduces idle memory use

body.zh-TW:
開發者在維護長期專案或將工具部署在輕量環境時，模型升級與底層資源消耗現在都有更省心的安排。

如果正在使用的模型即將淘汰，內建的 `openai-docs` 技能（skill，擴充 AI 能力的指引包）在引導遷移時，會直接根據官方文件推薦合適的替代模型。

針對安裝部署，DotSlash（按平台自動下載對應執行檔的發布工具）的設定清單現在會直接參照本次版本隨附發布的 Cargo 套件。

若是在 Linux musl 環境編譯，底層改用較少的記憶體配置區（allocator arenas，底層向系統申請記憶體的緩衝區塊），有效降低對話工作階段卸載之後殘留的閒置記憶體。
body.en:
For developers maintaining long-running projects or deploying tools in lightweight environments, model upgrades and underlying resource use now require less attention.

If the model you are using is being retired, the built-in `openai-docs` skill (a package of instructions that extends AI capabilities) now recommends a suitable replacement directly from the official documentation when guiding migration.

For installation and deployment, DotSlash (a tool that downloads the right executable for each platform) manifests now directly reference the Cargo packages shipped with this release.

Builds for Linux musl now use fewer allocator arenas (buffer blocks used to request memory from the system), reducing idle memory left behind after conversation sessions unload.

items.original:
The `openai-docs` skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model (#58134).
DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release (#58717, #58757).
Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload (#58399).

title.zh-TW: 鍵盤支援選取對話紀錄，按單字換行翻頁與內建搜尋
title.en: Keyboard Transcript Selection with Word, Line, and Page Motions and Integrated Search

body.zh-TW: 查閱終端機裡長串的除錯紀錄時，頻繁移開雙手去抓滑鼠反白文字常常打斷思緒。⟦宛若在厚重字典裡用檢索標籤翻查單字，以前只能用肉眼一行行硬找並手動標記，現在手指一撥就能按章節跳頁並直接定位字彙。⟧對話紀錄（終端機中保留的歷史問答內容）現在完整支援純鍵盤選取操作。你能使用鍵盤按單字、整行或整頁幅度移動游標，精準框選想複製的段落。介面內建搜尋功能，當你請 AI 檢查長篇日誌並想擷取特定段落時，直接鍵入關鍵字就能跳到該行。所有移動與選取的按鍵組合也開放自訂，方便你依照習慣配置個人快捷鍵。
body.en: When reviewing long debug logs in the terminal, frequently moving your hands away to grab the mouse and highlight text often breaks your train of thought. ⟦Think of looking up words in a thick dictionary using index tabs: in the past, you had to scan line by line with your eyes and mark text manually, whereas now a flick of the finger lets you skip across sections and pinpoint a vocabulary word directly.⟧ The transcript (historical question-and-answer exchanges kept in the terminal) now fully supports keyboard-only selection. You can use the keyboard to move the cursor by word, line, or page increments to precisely highlight the passages you want to copy. The interface features integrated search, so when you ask AI to inspect long logs and want to capture specific sections, typing keywords takes you straight to that line. All keybindings for motion and selection are also open to customization, making it easy to configure your personal shortcuts based on your habits.

items.original: Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts. (#57221, #57222, #57223, #57224)

title.zh-TW: 討論串回復與分支保留授權，佇列後可接續，子串一併復原
title.en: Thread Resuming and Forking Preserve Approvals with Queue Resume and Child Thread Restoration

body.zh-TW:
將中斷的工作階段重新接續或另開分支時，對話狀態與先前確認過的設定往往需要被妥善延續。

現在使用 `codex queue --resume` 指令，能在將新訊息加入佇列後，自動喚醒並接續已卸載的討論串。

當你回復既有進度或建立分支時，先前已經過確認的放行批准與權限設定會完整保留，不必在分支裡逐項重新授權。

回復與分支過程也會一併保留推理 token（AI 思考過程消耗的計費文字單位）的累計數據。這避免了系統因遺失思考紀錄而誤判對話長度，導致過早觸發上下文壓縮。

若先前將某個討論串封存，現在只要解封存該父討論串，所有由它衍生出的子討論串都會同步復原。以往分支後總要重新確認權限、子串在解封存時不知去向的麻煩，現在都不會再發生。
body.en:
When resuming an interrupted session or branching into a new fork, conversation state and previously confirmed settings often need to be properly carried forward.

Running the `codex queue --resume` command now automatically wakes and resumes unloaded threads after queueing a new message.

When you resume existing progress or create a fork, previously acknowledged approvals and permission settings are preserved in full, eliminating the need to reauthorize permissions item by item in the branch.

The resume and fork process also retains cumulative counts for reasoning tokens (billable text units consumed during an AI thought process). This prevents the system from misjudging conversation length due to lost deliberation records, which previously triggered premature context compaction.

If a thread was previously archived, unarchiving that parent thread now restores all child threads spawned from it simultaneously. The past annoyances of repeatedly re-confirming permissions after branching or losing track of child threads upon unarchiving no longer occur.

items.original:
Added `codex queue --resume` to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. (#57232)
Preserved acknowledged approval and permission settings when resuming or forking threads. (#57227)
Restored spawned descendant threads when unarchiving their parent. (#57635)
Preserved reasoning-token accounting across resume and fork to avoid premature compaction. (#57839)

title.zh-TW: 安全防護阻擋提示更清晰，提供替代提示詞直接選取
title.en: Clearer Safety-Block Explanations with Direct Selection of Safer Follow-Up Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入特定提示詞若意外觸發安全防護，突然中斷的對話常讓人摸不著頭緒。⟦彷彿圖書館珍本庫的借閱櫃台，以前被拒絕調閱只得到一張空白退件單，現在館員會清楚說明受限章則，還會主動列出可借閱的替代篇章。⟧終端使用者介面（TUI，以文字選單排版的終端畫面）現在提供更清楚的安全攔截說明。當你的請求因安全原則遭到阻擋時，畫面會明確解釋被限制的具體原因，不再只丟出一行模糊的拒絕訊息。介面同時會自動生成數個調整過措辭的安全替代提示詞，你可以直接按鍵盤選取並重新送出。這讓你在探索程式碼防護或敏感測試情境時，能立刻知道邊界在哪，並快速調整詢問方向繼續工作。
body.en: When entering certain prompts in the terminal unexpectedly triggers safety guardrails, a sudden conversation halt often leaves users bewildered. ⟦Picture the circulation desk of a rare book library: where a denied request once yielded only a blank rejection slip, the librarian now clearly explains the restricted regulations and proactively suggests alternative chapters available for loan.⟧ The TUI (terminal interface formatted with text-based menus) now provides clearer safety-block explanations. When your request is blocked due to safety policies, the screen clearly explains the specific reason for the restriction instead of merely returning a vague rejection line. The interface simultaneously generates several rephrased, safe follow-up prompts that you can select directly with your keyboard and resubmit. When exploring code defenses or sensitive testing scenarios, this lets you immediately recognize boundaries and swiftly adjust your questioning direction to continue working.

items.original: Added clearer safety-block explanations and selectable safer follow-up prompts in the TUI. (#57363, #57365)

title.zh-TW: 診斷指令新增專注網路選項，快速檢測連線與協定狀態
title.en: Focused Network Option Added to Doctor Command for Rapid Diagnostics

body.zh-TW:
當終端機突然連不上伺服器或回覆中斷時，快速抓出是本機環境還是網路連線出問題至關重要。⟦如同音響工程師拿著導線專用測試儀，以前排查雜音得把整套擴大機與調音台拆開通盤安檢，現在只要接上線頭就能單獨測量訊號導通狀況。⟧現在診斷工具新增了 `codex doctor --network-only` 參數選項。這項指令只針對設定、連線能力與 WebSocket（雙向即時通訊的網路協定）狀態做診斷。當你在公司內部網路或代理伺服器環境下遭遇請求逾時，只要打：

```bash
codex doctor --network-only
```

終端機就會只回報設定、連線與 WebSocket 這三項的檢查結果。
body.en:
When the terminal suddenly loses connection to the server or replies are cut off, quickly pinpointing whether the issue lies in the local environment or the network connection is critical. ⟦An audio engineer uses a dedicated cable tester: whereas troubleshooting noise previously required dismantling and inspecting the entire amplifier and mixing console, plugging in the leads now immediately tests signal continuity on its own.⟧ The diagnostic tool has now added the `codex doctor --network-only` option. This command runs diagnostics exclusively on configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket (a networking protocol for bidirectional real-time communication) status. When encountering request timeouts in corporate intranets or proxy environments, you simply run:

```bash
codex doctor --network-only
```

The terminal then reports only the configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket checks.

items.original: Added `codex doctor --network-only` for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. (#57606)

title.zh-TW: 獨立執行器隨附於正式安裝包，整頓背景服務與建置工具
title.en: Standalone Executor Shipped in Official Packages Alongside Service and Build Improvements

body.zh-TW: 在建置環境部署與升級工具時，底層架構的打包完整度與資源釋放直接影響執行穩定。正式釋出的命令列工具與 app-server（應用程式背景伺服器）安裝包中，現在已直接隨附獨立執行器。背景服務修復了執行緒啟動與關閉時的競爭衝突，執行完成後會即時釋放占用資源。同時，macOS 上若安裝路徑包含中文等非 ASCII 字元，或程式仍在使用中，獨立版本的清理錯誤也已修好。在專案建置方面，Bazel 改採原始碼自編譯的 V8 引擎，搭配相符的 Rust 綁定並支援 Windows 原生 MSVC 封裝；開發與正式發行版本也全面標準化至 Node.js 24.22.1 與 Rust 1.95.0。以往在特定路徑清理失敗或背景程序殘留資源的問題，現在都已排除。
body.en: When deploying and upgrading tools in build environments, the packaging integrity and resource release of underlying architectures directly dictate execution stability. Canonical CLI and app-server (application background server) release packages now bundle the standalone executor directly. The background service fixes thread startup and shutdown races, promptly releasing occupied resources upon completion. Meanwhile, standalone release cleanup errors on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters such as Chinese have also been resolved. For project builds, Bazel switches to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. Development and release builds are also standardized across the board on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. Past issues where cleanups failed on specific paths or background processes left lingering resources are now eliminated.

items.original:
Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. (#57503)
Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. (#57787, #57788)
Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. (#57164, #57269, #57644, #57832)
Shipped the standalone executor in canonical CLI and app-server release packages. (#57837)
Standardized development and release builds on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. (#57168, #57373)

title.zh-TW: 工作階段選擇器支援儲存庫篩選，指令中心依目錄分組
title.en: Session Picker Supports Repository Filtering, Agent Command Center Groups by Directory

body.zh-TW:
當你同時在多個專案副本間切換工作時，要在落落長的工作階段清單裡找出剛剛開啟的對話往往得費一番工夫。

在搭配 Git 工作樹（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）進行多工處理時，工作階段選擇器現在加入了儲存庫篩選機制，你可以快速過濾出屬於特定專案的工作階段。

⟦好比大型檔案庫整頓借閱卡，以前所有專案的借閱單全塞在同一個抽屜，找紀錄得一張張比對；現在能按專案名稱抽取專屬卡盒，櫃台還會按實體檔案夾分層收納。⟧

代理指令中心也同步支援目錄分組，會將關聯在同一工作樹目錄下的所有紀錄整合在一起，讓跨副本的工作階段瀏覽井然有序。當你一邊在主專案修復問題，另一邊在副本測試新功能時，只要開啟選擇器輸入專案名稱，就能切回目標對話，不再被其他專案的工作階段干擾。
body.en:
When juggling work across multiple project copies, locating a recently opened conversation in a long session list often takes considerable effort.

When multitasking with Git worktrees (a feature allowing multiple copies of the same project in parallel), the session picker now includes a repository filter, allowing you to quickly filter out sessions belonging to a specific project.

⟦Imagine a large archive reorganizing its checkout slips. Previously, slips from all projects were stuffed into a single drawer, forcing you to check records one by one. Now you can pull out a dedicated card box by project name, and the desk organizes them into tiers by physical folder.⟧

The agent command center now also supports directory grouping, bringing together all records associated with the same worktree directory to keep session navigation across copies neat and orderly. When you are fixing an issue in the main project while testing a new feature in a copy, you can simply open the picker and type the project name to switch back to the target conversation without distraction from other projects' sessions.

items.original: Added a repository filter to the session picker and directory grouping to the agent command center, making it easier to navigate sessions across linked worktrees. (#56308)

title.zh-TW: 應用伺服器 API 支援附加對話分支，實驗性拆分子討論串
title.en: App-Server API Supports Experimental Attached Thread Forks

body.zh-TW:
如果你正在透過應用伺服器介面開發專屬工具，想在同一個對話脈絡下嘗試不同解法時，管理獨立分支往往相當繁瑣。

`app-server` 的 API 現在加入了實驗性的附加對話分支（從既有對話衍生出附屬子討論串的機制）。這項功能讓應用程式能直接從既有對話拆出分支，既完整保留主線累積的上下文，又不會讓測試過程弄亂原本的紀錄。

⟦恰似在活頁筆記本貼上延伸標籤頁，以前想嘗試第二種草案只能整本重新謄寫，現在直接在關鍵頁面夾入附屬便箋，既保留原有筆記的脈絡，寫壞了也能隨時抽換。⟧

當你需要讓使用者對同一個問題評估多種修改方案時，就能透過這組介面拉出附屬討論串進行推演，讓主線對話隨時維持乾淨。
body.en:
If you are developing custom tools through the app-server interface and want to try different solutions within the same conversational context, managing separate branches can often be cumbersome.

The `app-server` API now includes experimental attached thread forks (a mechanism for branching secondary sub-threads from an existing conversation). This feature allows applications to branch directly off an existing conversation, preserving the full context accumulated in the main thread while preventing experiments from cluttering original records.

⟦Think of attaching extension tabs to a loose-leaf notebook. Previously, trying a second draft meant rewriting the entire notebook from scratch. Now you insert an attached memo directly into key pages, preserving the original context while letting you swap out bad drafts at any time.⟧

When you need users to evaluate multiple revision options for the same issue, you can use this interface to spin off secondary threads for exploration while keeping the primary conversation completely clean.

items.original: Added experimental attached thread forks to the app-server API. (#56351)

title.zh-TW: 支援對話途中調整思考力度，預設開放動態切換
title.en: Support for Adjusting Reasoning Effort Mid-Conversation, Enabled by Default

body.zh-TW:
向 AI 提問時如果一開始只隨口聊聊，隨後卻突然碰上需要抽絲剝繭的複雜架構，往往會受限於最初設定的思考程度。

針對有支援的模型，現在已經預設允許在對話途中直接修改思考力度（決定模型在回答前投入多少推理運算的參數）。你不再需要為了讓 AI 想得更深入而特地中斷對話另開新局，交談到一半隨時能依照問題難度靈活增減思考量。

⟦跟下西洋棋時切換思考時限一樣，以前開局選了快棋就只能一路快打到底，現在遇到膠著局面能當場多要幾分鐘長考，解開難題後又能切回節奏，不必把整盤棋推倒重來。⟧

當你原本只是請它解讀一段日常日誌，中途突然想探討分散式鎖的死結原因時，就能當場調高力度，讓模型針對核心邏輯進行深度推理。
body.en:
When asking an AI questions, starting with casual chat and then suddenly running into a complex architecture that demands deep dissection often leaves you constrained by your initial thinking depth.

For supported models, changing reasoning effort (the parameter determining how much reasoning computation the model invests before answering) during a conversation is now enabled by default. You no longer need to interrupt the conversation and start a new session just to make the AI think more deeply; you can flexibly adjust the amount of thinking midway based on question complexity.

⟦A chess clock adjustment reflects this transition. Previously, choosing blitz at the opening meant rushing through the entire match. Now, when a stalemate strikes, you can claim a few extra minutes on the spot to think deeply, then switch back to your normal pace once the puzzle is solved without resetting the board.⟧

When you initially ask it to interpret a routine log and suddenly decide to explore the root cause of a distributed lock deadlock midway through, you can increase the effort on the spot to let the model perform deep reasoning on the core logic.

items.original: Enabled reasoning effort changes during a conversation by default for supported models. (#56163)

title.zh-TW: 新設定檔預設啟用第二代記憶，支援匯入外部代理記憶
title.en: Fresh Profiles Enable Memory v2 by Default with Support for Importing External-Agent Memories

body.zh-TW:
每次建立新的個人設定檔時，如果希望 AI 能記住你的偏好或從其他工具轉移習慣，往往需要不少手動設定。

現在建立全新設定檔時，工具會預設啟用第二代記憶架構（讓工具跨對話保存使用者偏好的機制）。這套架構也同步支援匯入外部代理的記憶資料，能直接讀取其他 AI 工具先前累積的偏好與操作紀錄。

⟦如同搬進全新裝潢的智慧住宅，以前每次換新家都要重新訓練管家認識你的生活作息，現在進門就有現成的智慧管家隨時待命，還能直接把前任管家的備忘手冊整本讀取完畢。⟧

當你從其他開發助理切換到 Codex 時，不用再從頭教它你的排版風格與常用語法，只要把既有的記憶檔匯入，新設定檔就能立刻依循你的慣用模式工作。
body.en:
Whenever you create a new profile, having the AI remember your preferences or transfer habits from other tools usually requires considerable manual setup.

When creating fresh profiles, the tool now enables memory v2 (a mechanism allowing the tool to preserve user preferences across conversations) by default. This architecture also supports importing external-agent memories, directly reading preferences and operational logs accumulated in other AI tools.

⟦Consider moving into a newly renovated smart home. Previously, each move meant retraining a butler to learn your daily routine. Now, a ready-made smart butler is on standby the moment you enter, capable of reading through your previous butler's entire memo notebook.⟧

When switching from another coding assistant to Codex, you do not need to reteach your formatting style and preferred syntax from scratch; simply import your existing memory files, and the fresh profile will immediately work according to your established habits.

items.original: Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it. (#56211, #56414)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面在參數錯誤時保持可編輯，新工作階段沿用預設審核者
title.en: TUI Preferences Remain Editable on Invalid Settings, Fresh Sessions Honor Default Reviewer

body.zh-TW:
在終端介面操作工具時，如果遇到執行參數填寫錯誤，偏好設定選單一旦被連帶鎖死，往往會讓人動彈不得。

針對終端使用者介面（以純文字排版的終端機視窗），現在即便執行設定中存在無效參數，偏好設定依然保持可編輯狀態，且修改後能立即生效。新開啟的終端工作階段在未提供明確覆寫時，現在也會確實遵循伺服器的預設審核者規則。

⟦彷彿汽車儀表板的設定選單，以前只要感測器回報異常數值，整個操作面板就跟著卡死無法調整；現在各項控制選項依然能隨意修改並即時生效，新發動的車輛也會主動遵循車隊預設的安全指派。⟧

無論是不慎輸入了無效路徑，或是剛啟動全新的終端對話，介面都不會再無故罷工，各項審核權限也能正常運作。
body.en:
When operating tools in a terminal interface, if execution parameters are entered incorrectly and the preference menu freezes as a result, you are often left stuck.

For the terminal user interface (a text-based terminal display), preferences now remain editable and take effect immediately even when invalid parameters exist in execution settings. Fresh terminal sessions also properly honor the server's default approval reviewer rules when no explicit override is provided.

⟦The settings menu on a car dashboard mirrors this behavior. In the past, whenever a sensor reported an abnormal reading, the entire console froze and prevented adjustments. Now control options remain fully editable with immediate effect, and newly started vehicles actively follow default safety assignments set by the fleet.⟧

Whether you accidentally enter an invalid path or just launched a brand new terminal conversation, the interface will no longer freeze without cause, and approval permissions continue to function normally.

items.original:
Fixed fresh TUI sessions to honor the server’s default approval reviewer when no explicit override is provided. (#56090)
Kept TUI preferences editable and immediately applicable when execution settings are invalid. (#56091)

title.zh-TW: 中斷與取消時即刻停止背景運算，模型找不到不再盲目重試
title.en: Promptly Stop Background Tasks on Interrupt and Cancellation, Stop Blind Retries for Missing Models

body.zh-TW:
當你在操作過程中按下停止或遇到無效請求時，背景程式如果持續空轉或重複嘗試，往往會白白消耗運算資源與等待時間。

⟦有如辦公大樓的撤銷派工機制，以前專案喊停後外包廠商依然繼續趕工，送錯地址的公文還在不斷重複投遞；現在只要前端發出取消通知，所有外派作業與無效配送都會立刻剎車。⟧

第一項改動針對遠端 MCP 工具（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）。如果本機端已經取消或不再等待回傳結果，會主動向遠端發送取消通知，避免遠端伺服器徒勞運算。

第二項調整落在代理訊息排隊機制。當你在對話中按鍵中斷執行，或是切換到計畫模式時，已排隊的訊息不會再擅自重啟工作。

第三項改動則是在模型提供者回報找不到指定型號時，工具會立即停止重複嘗試，並完整保留原本的錯誤訊息。

以前遇到操作中斷或設定失效時，背景可能會持續重試或再度喚醒任務，現在各項失效請求都能及時收手。
body.en:
When you press stop during an operation or encounter an invalid request, background processes that continue idling or repeatedly retrying waste computing resources and waiting time.

⟦An office building's dispatch cancellation mechanism works in much the same way. Previously, contractors continued rushing work after a project was halted, and misaddressed documents were repeatedly redelivered. Now, once the front desk issues a cancellation notice, all dispatched tasks and invalid deliveries brake immediately.⟧

The first change applies to remote MCP tools (protocols that connect AI to external tools). If the local side has cancelled or no longer waits for returned results, it actively sends a cancellation notice to the remote side, preventing remote servers from wasting compute.

The second adjustment targets the agent message queuing mechanism. When you press a key to interrupt execution during a conversation or switch to Plan mode, queued messages will no longer restart work without permission.

The third change stops retrying immediately when a model provider reports that a specified model was not found, fully preserving the original error message.

Previously, when operations were interrupted or settings failed, background processes might continuously retry or wake tasks back up; now invalid requests cease promptly.

items.original:
Cancelled remote MCP tool requests when their local response futures are dropped. (#56132)
Prevented queued agent messages from restarting work after an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode. (#56330)
Stopped retrying when a provider reports that a model was not found, preserving its error message. (#56445)

title.zh-TW: 市集網址驗證補強防護，防範 Git 連線至未經授權的主機
title.en: Marketplace URL Validation Strengthened to Prevent Git Connecting to Unauthorized Hosts

body.zh-TW:
從擴充市集下載外掛或套件時，工具能否嚴格把關下載來源，攸關整個開發環境的安全。

市集網址的驗證機制現在補上了防護漏洞。以往在比對網址時存在落差，可能導致 Git 最終連線的主機，與安全名單中所允許的主機並不一致。這個驗證漏洞已經補上，Git 不會再連到與允許名單所檢查的不同主機。

⟦猶如社區門禁核對訪客名單，以前警衛登記的地址和訪客實際去的地方可能對不上，現在這個對不上的漏洞已經補上。⟧

這個問題已經修好，安裝市集套件時不會再因網址歧異而誤連至未授權的外部主機。
body.en:
When downloading plugins or packages from an extension marketplace, whether a tool strictly verifies download sources is vital to the security of your entire development environment.

The marketplace URL validation mechanism has now closed a security gap. In the past, discrepancies during URL matching could cause Git to ultimately connect to a different host from the one permitted on the safe list. This validation gap has been closed, ensuring Git will no longer connect to a host different from the one checked against the allowlist.

⟦Checking visitor logs at a gated community entrance reflects this safeguard. Previously, the address recorded by a guard might not match where a visitor actually went; now this mismatch loophole has been firmly closed.⟧

This issue has been fixed, so installing marketplace packages will no longer inadvertently connect to unauthorized external hosts due to URL discrepancies.

items.original: Closed a marketplace URL validation gap that could allow Git to connect to a different host than the one checked against allowed patterns. (#56263)

title.zh-TW: /presets 新增十組快捷欄位，常用提示詞與指令隨選即用
title.en: /presets adds ten shortcut slots for instant access to frequent prompts and commands

body.zh-TW: 當你反覆在對話中輸入相同的檢查指令或固定提問時，重新打字往往耗費時間。⟦宛若汽車音響上的電台記憶功能，以前想聽固定頻道每次都要手動調頻，現在可以選取已儲存的頻道。⟧現在你可以打 `/presets` 將常用的提示詞與斜線指令儲存到十個編號欄位中。呼叫時還會跳出專屬的鍵盤選單，讓你透過鍵盤快速選取所需的預設項目。例如每次開始整理報告時，就能透過鍵盤選單選取儲存好的審查指令，省去反覆翻找與複製貼上的麻煩。
body.en: When you repeatedly enter the same inspection commands or standard questions during a conversation, retyping them is often time-consuming. ⟦Picture a car radio with station presets, where listening to a favorite channel once required manual tuning each time, but now only takes selecting a saved station.⟧ You can now type `/presets` to store frequently used prompts and slash commands into ten numbered slots. Invoking it brings up a dedicated keyboard menu so you can quickly choose the preset you need. For example, whenever you start compiling a report, you can select a saved review command through the keyboard menu, eliminating the hassle of searching around and copy-pasting.

items.original: Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381)

title.zh-TW: /model 與 /permissions 支援行內參數，單行直接套用設定
title.en: /model and /permissions support inline arguments to apply settings in one command

body.zh-TW: 臨時需要切換模型或調整執行權限時，你可以把要用的設定直接接在指令後面。⟦如同在義式咖啡機直接轉動濃淡旋鈕，以前分開調整的出杯速度與風味濃度，現在點選飲品時順手一扭就能一併指定。⟧現在打 `/model` 或 `/permissions` 時，可以直接在同一行指令接上參數。你能直接在指令後方指定模型名稱、運算速度與推理解題力度（reasoning effort）。如果需要變更授權層級，也可以透過行內參數指定權限設定檔（permission profile）。這讓你輸入一行指令就能立刻切換到所需的執行環境。
body.en: When you need to switch models or adjust execution permissions on the fly, you can append your desired settings directly to the command. ⟦Think of turning a brew strength knob on an espresso machine, where cup speed and flavor intensity once had to be adjusted separately, but now can be set with a quick twist when selecting a beverage.⟧ When typing `/model` or `/permissions`, you can now pass arguments directly on the same line. You can specify the model name, compute speed, and reasoning effort right after the command. If you need to change authorization levels, you can also specify a permission profile through inline arguments. This lets you switch immediately to the required runtime environment with a single command.

items.original: Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. (#54378, #54383)

title.zh-TW: 支援 Kitty 與 Sixel 協定，全螢幕紀錄直接預覽圖片
title.en: Kitty and Sixel protocols supported to preview images directly in fullscreen logs

body.zh-TW: 在純文字終端機中請 AI 產生或查看圖片時，常常必須切換到外部檢視器才能確認成果。⟦彷彿按下數位相機快門後直接在電子觀景窗回放相片，以前非得把記憶卡插進電腦螢幕才能檢視構圖，現在眼睛不用離開目鏡就能看清影像細節。⟧如果你的終端機支援 Kitty 或 Sixel 圖形協定，現在全螢幕對話紀錄中可以直接預覽圖片。無論是讓工具讀取既有的本機圖檔，或是由模型新產生的圖片，畫面都會直接在紀錄中渲染顯示，不必再特地跳出視窗開啟檔案。
body.en: When asking AI to generate or inspect images in a plain-text terminal, you often have to switch to an external viewer to verify results. ⟦Much like checking a digital camera's electronic viewfinder right after pressing the shutter, where reviewing composition once required plugging a memory card into a computer monitor, you can now inspect image details without taking your eye off the eyepiece.⟧ If your terminal supports the Kitty or Sixel graphics protocol, you can now preview images directly inside fullscreen conversation transcripts. Whether the tool reads an existing local image file or displays a new image generated by the model, the graphic renders directly within the log without opening an external window.

items.original: Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216)

title.zh-TW: 企業級 MCP 支援專用登入與帳號授權，納入金鑰用戶端
title.en: Enterprise MCP supports dedicated login and account authorization with secret client access

body.zh-TW: 企業團隊在將內部系統串接至外部工具時，往往受限於嚴格的身分核驗與安全規範。⟦跟持員工證進入特約商務中心一樣，以前訪客通道只能辨識一般識別貼紙，現在閘門不僅支援企業總部的數位權限卡，也能核對附帶安全密鑰的專屬通行條。⟧現在企業級 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）連線支援更多元的驗證方式。你可以使用符合資格的 Codex 帳號授權直接通行，或是使用專屬登入通道完成驗證。對於需要用戶端密鑰（client secret）的 OAuth 用戶端，現在也能順利通過身分確認，安全連接各項企業服務。
body.en: When enterprise teams connect internal systems to external tools, they are often constrained by strict identity verification and security policies. ⟦Just as entering a partner business center with an employee badge once only supported basic visitor decals, the gate now accepts corporate digital access cards as well as dedicated passes with security keys.⟧ Enterprise MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) connections now support more diverse authentication methods. You can authenticate directly using eligible Codex account authorization or complete verification through dedicated login channels. OAuth clients requiring client secrets can now also pass identity verification smoothly and securely connect to various enterprise services.

items.original: Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001)

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 設定精靈預設啟用，自動整合 AWS 登入方式
title.en: Amazon Bedrock setup wizard enabled by default to integrate AWS login methods

body.zh-TW: 初次在工具中設定雲端模型提供者時，複雜的認證流程常讓人無所適從。⟦好比智慧電視初次開機的引導流程，以前要自己翻出網路線與遙控器代碼手動輸入，現在一開機就自動跳出連線精靈，還會把同品牌的登入選項整合在同一個畫面。⟧現在 Amazon Bedrock 的設定引導精靈改為預設開啟。當系統偵測到環境中的憑證時，API 金鑰輸入選項會自動與其他 AWS 登入方式歸類在同一個區塊，讓你清楚檢視並選取合適的登入途徑，不必再四處尋找設定入口。
body.en: When configuring a cloud model provider in the tool for the first time, complex authentication flows can feel overwhelming. ⟦Consider the initial setup guide of a smart TV, where you once had to find Ethernet cables and enter remote codes manually, but now a setup wizard appears automatically and brings brand login options together on one screen.⟧ The configuration setup wizard for Amazon Bedrock is now enabled by default. When credentials are detected in the environment, the API key input option is automatically grouped into the same section alongside other AWS login methods. This allows you to clearly view and select the appropriate sign-in path without searching around for configuration menus.

items.original: The Amazon Bedrock setup wizard is now enabled by default, with API key entry grouped alongside other AWS sign-in methods when credentials are detected. (#56033, #56023)

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮失敗自動備援，恢復工作階段完整保留討論串設定
title.en: Compaction failures fall back smoothly while resumed sessions preserve thread settings

body.zh-TW: 長時間與 AI 討論累積了大量對話紀錄時，背後的摘要壓縮機制是維持流暢對答的關鍵。⟦就像編輯長篇文件時的自動存檔機制，以前存檔失敗會在草稿夾留下一半的殘缺摘要，重開檔案時個人偏好也被重設成原廠設定；現在即使背景壓縮失敗也會平穩備援，重新開啟時還能精準還原原本的排版。⟧現在對話歷史壓縮（compaction）若不幸失敗，不會再於對話紀錄中留下半截殘缺的摘要內容，背景壓縮失敗時也會安全備援而不引發程式異常崩潰。恢復工作階段（session）時，工具現在能確實找到已壓縮的歷史紀錄，並完整復原原本討論串儲存的設定，而不是擅自將它們覆蓋成全域預設值。
body.en: When extensive discussions with AI accumulate substantial conversation history, the underlying summary compaction mechanism is essential for maintaining smooth exchanges. ⟦Like an autosave feature while editing a long document, where a save failure once left a broken half-summary in drafts and reset personal preferences to factory defaults upon reopening, background compaction failures now fall back smoothly and restore original layouts upon relaunch.⟧ If conversation history compaction fails, it no longer leaves partial summary fragments in transcripts, and background compaction failures now fall back safely without triggering crashes. When resuming a session, the tool reliably finds compacted history and fully restores the thread's saved settings instead of overwriting them with global defaults.

items.original:
Failed compaction no longer leaves partial summaries in conversation history, and background compaction failures fall back without panicking. (#53932, #55581)
Resuming sessions now finds compressed histories and restores saved thread settings instead of replacing them with global defaults. (#54008, #55923)

title.zh-TW: 自動清理未使用的安裝與市集暫存，設定日誌上限釋放磁碟空間
title.en: Prune unused installs and marketplace caches while capping daemon logs to free disk space

body.zh-TW: 工具在背景持續運作或頻繁下載外掛後，磁碟空間常常在不知不覺間被暫存檔案佔滿。⟦類似手機定期執行儲存空間大掃除，以前沒在用的舊版本與未再使用的檔案包會一直堆在角落，背景服務的紀錄簿也無限膨脹；現在清理工具會主動清空廢棄包裝，並替紀錄簿設下頁數上限。⟧現在工具加入了多項磁碟維護機制來降低空間佔用。系統會主動修剪不再使用的安裝版本，清理市集中已棄置的 checkout（取出的檔案副本）。同時替常駐程式（daemon）的日誌檔案設定大小上限，防止日誌無限制增長消耗硬碟空間。
body.en: When tools run continuously in the background or download plugins frequently, disk space often fills up unnoticed with temporary files. ⟦Similar to periodic storage cleanups on a smartphone, where unused old versions and abandoned package archives once piled up in corners while background logs grew without bound, cleanup tools now purge obsolete packages and cap log pages.⟧ The tool now includes several disk maintenance mechanisms to reduce disk usage. The system actively prunes unused installation versions and cleans up abandoned marketplace checkouts (extracted working copies of files). It also sets a size limit on daemon log files to prevent logs from growing indefinitely and consuming disk storage.

items.original: Reduced disk usage by pruning unused installations, cleaning abandoned marketplace checkouts, and bounding daemon logs. (#53827, #55149, #55689, #55690, #55856)

title.zh-TW: 強化執行環境安全防護，遮蔽終端機憑證並嚴格檢驗路徑
title.en: Harden runtime security by masking terminal credentials and strictly validating paths

body.zh-TW:
在執行腳本或調用系統環境時，防止敏感資訊外洩與防堵潛在執行漏洞是保障系統安全的核心關鍵。

終端機操作方面，支援的遠端 Bash 指令與 Zsh 快照工作階段（session）現在會自動遮蔽各類憑證，包含來自自訂提供者的敏感認證金鑰，避免機密在紀錄或螢幕輸出中曝光。

沙盒防護也有所強化，針對 macOS 系統上大小寫變形的中繼資料路徑，以及用來尋找執行檔的符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），都加入了嚴格的檢驗機制，防止路徑被惡意替換。

內嵌的 JavaScript 執行環境也完成更新，為最佳化後的 `Array.sort` 排序操作加入安全檢查，防範異常。以前在遠端執行或排查腳本時容易擔心金鑰外洩或路徑被掉包，現在各個執行環節都有專門的安全防線把關。
body.en:
When executing scripts or invoking system environments, preventing sensitive information leaks and closing potential execution vulnerabilities are essential to securing the system.

For terminal operations, supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions now automatically mask various credentials, including sensitive authentication keys from custom providers, preventing secrets from being exposed in logs or screen output.

Sandbox defenses have also been strengthened by adding strict validation mechanisms against case-variant metadata paths on macOS and symlinks (shortcut files pointing to another location) used to locate executables, preventing paths from being maliciously substituted.

The embedded JavaScript runtime has also been updated to add safety checks to optimized `Array.sort` operations, guarding against anomalies. While running or debugging scripts remotely once raised concerns about leaked keys or swapped paths, dedicated security safeguards now protect each execution stage.

items.original:
Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers. (#54309, #54432, #56049)
Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384)
Updated the embedded JavaScript runtime with safety checks for optimized `Array.sort` operations. (#54519)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援代理伺服器驗證，指令列設定覆寫與排隊流程修復
title.en: Windows supports proxy authentication alongside fixes for CLI config overrides and prompt queuing

body.zh-TW:
在企業網路環境或複雜的指令列流程中，連線驗證與參數傳遞的正確性直接影響工作進展。

在 Windows 系統中，HTTPS 與 WebSocket 連線現在能正確處理代理伺服器（proxy）的驗證要求，自動使用已登入使用者的 Negotiate 或 NTLM 憑證完成身分查核，避免連線失敗中斷。

在終端機執行多層子指令時，若在不同層級重複帶入 `-c` 或 `--config` 參數，現在各層級的設定覆寫值都會完整保留，不再被意外覆蓋或遺失。

排隊等待執行的提示詞也調整了執行邏輯，現在會確實等候前方擱置中的權限確認選單完成選擇，才會繼續往下執行。以前遇到內網代理或連續提問時容易卡在連線中斷或權限錯亂，現在整套指令與排程流程都能順暢運行。
body.en:
In enterprise network environments or complex command-line workflows, the reliability of connection authentication and parameter passing directly impacts work progress.

On Windows, HTTPS and WebSocket connections now properly handle proxy authentication challenges by automatically verifying identities with the logged-in user's Negotiate or NTLM credentials, preventing connection failures.

When running nested subcommands in the terminal with `-c` or `--config` arguments repeated across different levels, configuration overrides at each tier are now fully preserved instead of being accidentally overwritten or lost.

Queued prompts have also received updated execution logic, now reliably waiting for preceding pending permission menus to finish their selection before continuing execution. While corporate proxies or consecutive prompts once led to dropped connections or permission mix-ups, the entire command and scheduling pipeline now runs smoothly.

CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022)
Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682)

title.zh-TW: /config 支援跨類別搜尋設定，即時修改並提示重啟
title.en: /config Supports Cross-Category Setting Search, Instant Edits, and Restart Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當你想調整 Codex 的各項參數，卻記不清具體設定名稱藏在哪個分類時，現在直接輸入 `/config` 就能解決。⟦彷彿走進大型量販店使用智慧導覽機，以前要一層層貨架慢慢找商品，現在直接搜尋關鍵字就能立刻取貨，機器還會貼心提醒哪些生鮮結帳後必須馬上冷藏。⟧輸入 `/config` 後，你可以跨越不同分類快速搜尋偏好設定，支援的選項能當場修改；哪些變更需要重啟，介面也會清楚標示，不必再自己猜測設定是否需要重啟。
body.en: When you want to adjust parameters in Codex but cannot recall which category a specific setting is tucked under, typing `/config` now solves the problem immediately. ⟦Picture using a smart kiosk in a large wholesale store: previously you had to browse through aisle after aisle of shelves to find an item, but now searching by keyword lets you pick it up immediately, and the machine even helpfully reminds you which perishables must be refrigerated right after checkout.⟧ After entering `/config`, you can quickly search for preferences across different categories, and supported options can be modified on the spot. The interface also clearly indicates which changes require a restart, sparing you from guessing whether a setting demands one.

items.original: Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)

title.zh-TW: 生成中途可即時追問轉向，中斷時同步停止程式碼與工具呼叫
title.en: Steer Generations Mid-Stream with Follow-Up Prompts, Halting Code and Tool Calls on Interrupt

body.zh-TW: 看著 AI 劈頭往錯誤的方向洋洋灑灑寫下去，你不用再乾等它講完廢話才能打字糾正。⟦好比教練在場邊即時對球員大喊變更戰術，以前只能眼睜睜看著整套戰術打完才能檢討，現在哨音一響場上球員立刻改變跑位，正在熱身準備上場的替補球員也會全部停下動作。⟧Codex 正在回答的當下，你可以隨時送出後續追問來即時引導思考方向。如果你決定中斷這次回應，正在執行的 Code Mode（逐格執行程式碼的模式）儲存格會立刻停止，連同其巢狀工具呼叫也一併結束，避免背景程序白白空轉。
body.en: Watching the AI dash off in the wrong direction with paragraph after paragraph, you no longer have to wait idly until it finishes before typing a correction. ⟦Think of a coach shouting tactical changes from the sidelines to players in real time: previously you had to watch the entire play run its course before reviewing it, but now players shift positions the moment the whistle blows, while bench substitutes warming up to enter the game halt their movements as well.⟧ While Codex is in the middle of responding, you can send follow-up prompts at any time to steer its train of thought on the fly. If you decide to interrupt the response, currently executing Code Mode (a mode that executes code cell by cell) cells stop immediately, and their nested tool calls are terminated alongside them, preventing background processes from spinning in vain.

items.original: Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)

title.zh-TW: /keymap 支援自訂前導鍵，快捷鍵提示常駐且語音靜音改為 F9
title.en: /keymap Supports Custom Leader Keys, Sticky Shortcut Prompts, and Moves Voice Mute to F9

body.zh-TW: 習慣用鍵盤快速叫出各種操作的讀者，現在調整自訂按鍵更加得心應手。⟦如同樂團指揮設定了預備拍，以前比劃動作稍縱即逝容易漏看，現在提示手勢會穩穩停在空中等你接招，也把靜音操作換到另一個指定琴鍵。⟧在 `/keymap` 設定中，你可以自由配置前導鍵（按下一組按鍵後等待後續指令的引導鍵），系統預設組合為 `Ctrl+X`。按下後跳出的快捷鍵提示會持續停留在畫面上，直到你做出選擇或取消為止。語音靜音功能則移到了 `F9` 按鍵。
body.en: Readers accustomed to invoking operations swiftly via the keyboard can now customize key bindings with far greater ease. ⟦Imagine an orchestra conductor establishing a preparatory beat: previously the fleeting gesture was easily missed, but now the cueing hand rests steadily in the air waiting for your response, while the mute control is reassigned to another designated piano key.⟧ Within `/keymap` settings, you can freely configure a leader key (a guiding key that waits for follow-up inputs once pressed), with the system defaulting to `Ctrl+X`. The shortcut prompt that appears after pressing it remains on screen until you make a choice or cancel. Voice muting has been moved to the `F9` key.

items.original: Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)

title.zh-TW: /daemon 支援重啟背景伺服器，中斷前主動警告並自動重連
title.en: /daemon Supports Restarting Background Servers with Disruption Warnings and Auto-Reconnect

body.zh-TW: 當背景執行的伺服器連線卡住或需要重載時，你不必再大費周章手動終止處理程序。⟦就像大樓總電源維護前廣播通知，以前電閘一拉整棟直接斷電，現在管理員會先警告哪些電梯與設備即將暫停，重啟完畢後還會自動幫大家把照明重新接通。⟧現在從 `/daemon` 指令就能直接重啟受管的背景伺服器（常駐在系統底層默默運作的背景程序）。重啟前，Codex 會先跳出警告，提醒這次重啟可能會中斷哪些進行中的工作。確認執行後，系統會在伺服器重啟完成時自動重新連線，省去手動重連的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: When a background server connection hangs or requires a reload, you no longer need to go through the hassle of manually killing the process. ⟦Consider a building announcement prior to main electrical maintenance: previously throwing the main switch cut power to the entire building without ceremony, but now the superintendent first warns which elevators and facilities will temporarily halt, and automatically reconnects lighting once the restart completes.⟧ You can now restart managed background servers (daemons running quietly at the system level) directly from the `/daemon` command. Before restarting, Codex displays a warning outlining which active tasks might be disrupted. Once confirmed, the system automatically reconnects as soon as the server finishes rebooting, eliminating tedious manual reconnection steps.

items.original: Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)

title.zh-TW: 唯讀工具支援平行執行，技能、記憶與對話紀錄查詢不再排隊
title.en: Read-Only Tools Support Parallel Execution: Skills, Memory, and Session History Queries No Longer Queue Up

body.zh-TW: 提問時需要 AI 同時調閱多項過往資訊的讀者，現在能感受到明顯更快的查詢反應。⟦跟圖書館調派多位館員同時分頭找書一樣，以前一個人要先找完歷史檔案才能去翻閱典藏技能，現在三位館員各自朝不同書架出發，找齊資料後一口氣交到你手上。⟧Codex 現在能夠平行（同時多工處理而不依序等待）執行彼此互不干擾的獨立唯讀工具。這項機制涵蓋了擴充技能檢索、記憶調閱，以及對話歷史紀錄查詢。這些互不衝突的讀取工作現在能同步展開，縮短等待回答的時間。
body.en: Readers whose questions require the AI to retrieve multiple pieces of past information at once will now notice noticeably faster query responses. ⟦A library dispatches multiple librarians to fetch books simultaneously: where one person previously had to search historical archives before checking archived skills, three librarians now head toward separate shelves at once and deliver everything into your hands the moment it is gathered.⟧ Codex can now execute mutually independent read-only tools in parallel (processing tasks concurrently without waiting in line). This mechanism covers skill retrieval, memory lookups, and session history queries. These non-conflicting read tasks now run concurrently, cutting down the wait time for answers.

items.original: Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)

title.zh-TW: Daybreak 模型對合格帳號預設啟用，codex exec 支援金鑰指定選用
title.en: Daybreak Model Enabled by Default for Eligible Accounts, with Key-Based Selection in codex exec

body.zh-TW: 想體驗最新 Daybreak 模型的讀者，只要帳號符合資格，打開程式就能直接用上。⟦宛若高鐵會員自動升級商務車廂，以前必須特地到櫃檯出示證件申請，現在符合條件的旅客刷票進站就能直接入座，在自動售票機輸入個人憑證也能順利劃位。⟧針對符合資格的帳號，Codex 現已預設啟用 Daybreak 模型。如果你習慣使用終端機指令 `codex exec` 執行任務，在伺服器提供存取權限的前提下，只要附上 OpenAI API 金鑰（存取雲端服務的通關密鑰），也能透過該指令自由選用 Daybreak 模型。
body.en: Readers eager to experience the latest Daybreak model can now use it right out of the box, provided their account is eligible. ⟦A high-speed rail membership automatically upgrades passengers to business class: where travelers once had to present identification at the counter to apply, eligible passengers can now swipe their tickets at the gate to take their seats directly, while entering personal credentials at automated ticketing machines also secures a seat smoothly.⟧ Codex now enables the Daybreak model by default for eligible accounts. If you prefer running tasks with the terminal command `codex exec`, you can also freely select the Daybreak model through that command by supplying an OpenAI API key (the secret pass for accessing cloud services), provided the server grants access.

items.original: Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

title.zh-TW: 對話串切換支援 /side 回到分支，重啟時完整恢復授權與網路許可
title.en: Thread Switching Supports /side to Return to Branches, Fully Restoring Authorizations and Network Permissions on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 頻繁在多個任務之間切換對話串（在同一專案中分頭進行的獨立對話紀錄）的讀者，現在不用擔心進度與設定跑位。⟦有如在辦公室借調多份專案公文，以前換個案子審核印章就得重新蓋過，現在換回舊案能直接調閱已批准的用印紀錄，派出去的公文回函也會精準送回當初發文的專案夾。⟧切換對話串後，你可以隨時輸入 `/side` 指令回到先前的旁支對話。如果切換前有尚未回覆完畢的提示詞，產生的答案也會準確送回當初提問的對話串。當你重新打開已保存的對話串時，先前擁有的權限與網路存取許可都會完整還原，同時依然遵守手動覆寫與現行的管理政策。
body.en: Readers who frequently switch between threads (independent conversation logs running concurrently in the same project) no longer need to worry about losing progress or configuration state. ⟦Handling multiple project dossiers in an office setting once required restamping approvals whenever you switched cases, but returning to an earlier case now pulls up previously approved seal records directly, and replies to dispatched memos return precisely to the originating project folder.⟧ After switching threads, you can type the `/side` command at any point to return to a previous side discussion. If a prompt was still generating when you switched, the resulting response is routed accurately back to the thread where the question originated. When reopening a saved thread, your previously granted authorizations and network access permissions are fully restored, while continuing to respect manual overrides and active administrative policies.

items.original:
Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)

title.zh-TW: 網路代理加強防護：DNS 查詢前先審核、阻擋重複標頭與憑證別名繞過
title.en: Network Proxy Security Tightens: Pre-DNS Query Audits, Blocking Duplicate Headers and Credential Alias Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 在需要透過代理伺服器連接外部網路的環境中，這項更新替連線安全築起了更嚴格的防線。⟦猶如機場海關加強查驗流程，以前旅客報出目的地前不會先核驗護照，現在查驗官在查詢航線前就先確認出境許可，嚴查重複填寫的申報表，也不再讓換了別名的違禁證件繞過檢查站。⟧網路代理現在會在發起網域名稱查詢（將網址轉譯為伺服器位址的查詢）前，先行檢查該連線是否具備相應權限。代理伺服器也會主動拒絕帶有重複 `Host` 標頭的請求，並防止憑證別名繞過檢查掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），杜絕未經授權的潛在連線漏洞。
body.en: In environments that route external network traffic through a proxy server, this update erects a stricter line of defense for connection security. ⟦Customs inspectors at an airport checkpoint tighten screening procedures: where officers previously did not verify passports before travelers stated their destinations, inspectors now confirm exit permits before looking up flight routes, strictly scrutinize duplicate declaration forms, and block contraband credentials disguised under aliases from slipping past checkpoints.⟧ The network proxy now verifies whether a connection holds appropriate permissions before initiating a domain name query (resolving a web address into a server destination). The proxy server also actively rejects requests bearing duplicate `Host` headers and prevents credential aliases from bypassing check hooks (small routines triggered when specific events occur), plugging potential unauthorized connection loopholes.

items.original: The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援快捷鍵貼圖，WSL 剪貼簿重複讀取並防止複製卡死
title.en: Windows Gains Image Pasting Shortcuts, While WSL Reuses Clipboard Readers and Prevents Copy Freezes

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 或 WSL（Windows 系統內建的 Linux 子系統）環境下操作終端機的讀者，剪貼內容時將順暢許多。⟦恰似換了一組靈敏的櫃檯讀卡機，兩組指定快捷鍵都能把文字與圖片直接貼進視窗；頻繁讀取時能共用讀取模組，複製操作也會逾時退出，不再一直卡住。⟧在 Windows 中，`Ctrl+V` 與 `Shift+Insert` 現在都能貼上文字與圖片。而在 WSL 環境下，連續多次貼上會重複使用剪貼簿讀取器；複製操作在遇到阻礙時則會逾時退出，不再無休止地卡死畫面。
body.en: Readers running terminals under Windows or WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) will experience far smoother clipboard workflows. ⟦Upgrading to a responsive card reader at a checkout counter allows two designated shortcuts to feed both text and images straight into the window, frequent scans share the reader module, and stalled copy operations time out instead of hanging indefinitely.⟧ On Windows, both `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` can now paste text and images. Under WSL, successive pastes reuse the clipboard reader, while copy operations encountering obstacles time out gracefully rather than freezing the screen indefinitely.

items.original: On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)

title.zh-TW: 指令輸出修復：本地與遠端傳輸更穩，codex exec 不再重複印出差異
title.en: Command Output Fixes: Steadier Local and Remote Transfers, codex exec Stops Reprinting Diffs

body.zh-TW: 經常在終端機執行本機指令或遠端遙控工作的讀者，這次更新修復了多項令指令卡住或資訊混亂的輸出問題。⟦宛如貨運物流中心整頓了出貨流程，以前只要下游包裝箱還沒封口，送貨司機就算卸完貨也只能在原地枯等，現在確認卸貨完成就能迅速出發，晚到的包裹也能妥善入庫而不被遺漏。⟧以前執行本機指令時，只要底層的子行程（由主程式衍生出來獨立處理任務的分支程式）沒有關閉輸出管道，整個指令就會乾等而不肯結束。現在本地指令在工作完成後能迅速結束。執行遠端指令時，晚到的輸出內容現在會妥善保留，確保最後一次輪詢時依然能完整收集。使用 `codex exec` 執行無關指令後，終端機也不會再重複印出先前的檔案差異清單。
body.en: For readers who regularly run local commands or remote tasks in the terminal, this update resolves several output glitches that previously hung commands or cluttered information. ⟦A freight logistics hub overhauls its shipping workflow: previously, as long as downstream packing crates remained unsealed, delivery drivers had to wait idly on site even after finishing unloading, but now drivers depart promptly once unloading is confirmed, and late-arriving parcels are safely warehoused rather than missed.⟧ Previously when running local commands, as long as underlying subprocesses (child processes spawned by the main program to handle tasks independently) kept output pipes open, the overall command would stall indefinitely rather than terminate. Local commands now exit promptly once their work is done. When executing remote commands, late-arriving output is now safely retained, ensuring it is fully collected during the final poll. Running unrelated commands via `codex exec` also no longer causes the terminal to reprint previous file diffs.

items.original:
Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
`codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

title.zh-TW: 隨附技術文件更新：收錄 GPT-6 遷移指引與 Linux 沙箱架構說明
title.en: Bundled Documentation Update: GPT-6 Migration Guide and Linux Sandbox Architecture Details

body.zh-TW: 正在規劃將專案升級至新世代模型，或關注系統底層安全防護的讀者，現在能從隨附文件中查閱更詳盡的官方指南。⟦正如工廠設備手冊換上新版擴建指南，不僅詳細列出升級新型機具時的運轉特性與資料所在地考量，也公開了安全防護罩如何隔絕危險區域並過濾高壓氣流。⟧隨附的 OpenAI 文件已更新針對 GPT-6 系列模型的遷移指引，詳細說明了各模型特定的推理特性、外部工具使用方式，以及資料駐留（資料儲存與處理的地理位置）相關考量。隨附說明也進一步釐清了 Linux 沙箱機制的運作方式，詳細介紹系統如何透過 bubblewrap 達成檔案系統隔離，並藉由 seccomp 進行系統呼叫過濾。
body.en: Readers planning to upgrade projects to next-generation models or keeping an eye on low-level system security can now consult more detailed official guidance in the bundled documentation. ⟦A factory equipment manual swaps in a fresh expansion guide, not only detailing the operational characteristics and data location considerations when upgrading to new machinery, but also revealing how safety shields isolate hazardous areas and filter high-pressure airflow.⟧ The bundled OpenAI documentation updates migration guidance for the GPT-6 model family, detailing model-specific reasoning characteristics, external tool usage, and data residency (the geographic location where data is stored and processed) considerations. The bundled documentation also clarifies how the Linux sandbox mechanism operates, detailing how the system achieves filesystem isolation through bubblewrap and filters system calls via seccomp.

items.original:
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

title.zh-TW: 安裝包體積縮減，改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器並提示設定遷移
title.en: Package Size Reduced with Codex's Standard Shell Runner and Config Migration Notice

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 與 macOS 環境下安裝或更新 Codex 的讀者，這次會發現下載更輕盈且底層執行器更單純。⟦與出差輕裝上陣的概念相同，以前行李箱裡硬塞了一整套自備工具組，現在改用原有的標準工具，並把非必要的裝飾吊牌全數卸下，讓行李箱體積與重量減輕不少。⟧官方透過從安裝二進位檔中剝除符號（除錯用的內部名稱標籤），縮減了 Linux 與 macOS 版本的安裝套件體積，原始建置產物則依然保留完整符號。在執行架構上，Codex 現在改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器（負責執行命令的工具），不再隨附修補版的 `zsh`。如果既有設定仍包含已淘汰的 shell 標記，系統會跳出遷移通知協助你平順過渡。
body.en: Readers installing or updating Codex on Linux and macOS will find lighter downloads and a simpler underlying runner. ⟦A business traveler packs light under the same principle: rather than stuffing a custom toolkit into a suitcase, they rely on existing standard tools and strip away nonessential decorative tags, significantly reducing suitcase size and weight.⟧ The team reduced package sizes for Linux and macOS releases by stripping symbols (internal name labels used for debugging) from installation binaries, while raw build artifacts still retain full symbols. In terms of execution architecture, Codex now switches to Codex's standard shell runner (a tool responsible for executing commands), no longer bundling a patched `zsh`. If existing configurations still contain deprecated shell flags, the system displays a migration notice to help you transition smoothly.

items.original:
Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

Fixed startup failures caused by differences between a running background server's feature settings and CLI defaults. Compatibility checks now apply only to explicit command-line feature overrides. (#52648)

title.zh-TW: 終端機顯示多行提問不再當機
title.en: Terminal Displaying Multiline Prompts No Longer Crashes

body.zh-TW: 當你在文字視窗等待背景任務，途中跳出落落長的確認提問時，畫面不會再突然卡死關閉。以前遇到非同步提問（程式在背後運作時插進來詢問意見的對話）包含多行文字，終端機文字介面常會直接當機。這個問題現在已經修好，訊息裡的換行排版會原樣保留，附帶的超連結完整網址也不會遺失。以前常因為介面當機而看不到完整問題，現在長內容與跳轉連結都能順利讀取。
body.en: When you wait for background tasks in a text window and a lengthy confirmation prompt pops up along the way, the screen will no longer suddenly freeze and close. Previously, when asynchronous prompts (dialogues that interrupt to ask for input while programs run in the background) contained multiline text, the terminal text interface often crashed directly. This issue is now fixed, with line breaks in messages preserved as formatted and full URLs in attached hyperlinks no longer lost. While users previously often missed full questions due to interface crashes, long content and redirect links can now be read smoothly.

items.original: Fixed a TUI crash when asynchronous questions contain multiple lines, preserving line breaks and complete hyperlink destinations. (#51866)

title.zh-TW: 命令列啟動不再因背景伺服器設定不同而失敗
title.en: Command-Line Startup No Longer Fails Over Differing Background Server Settings

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣讓工具在背後持續運作，開新視窗輸入指令時，不必再擔心程式卡在開頭進不去。以前只要正在執行的背景伺服器與命令列介面（CLI，用文字指令操作的工具）預設設定不同，啟動就會報錯失敗。現在相容性檢查只會在命令列明確覆寫功能時才進行，啟動失敗的問題已經修好。以前常因預設值不同而被擋在門外，現在就算背景設定有別也能順利開啟。
body.en: If you are used to letting tools run continuously in the background, you no longer need to worry about programs getting stuck at startup when entering commands in a new window. Previously, whenever the running background server and the command-line interface (tools operated with text commands) had different default settings, startup would fail with an error. Now, compatibility checks only run when the command line explicitly overrides features, and the startup failure issue has been fixed. While users were previously locked out due to differing default values, the tool can now launch smoothly even when background configurations differ.

items.original: Fixed startup failures caused by differences between a running background server's feature settings and CLI defaults. Compatibility checks now apply only to explicit command-line feature overrides. (#52648)

title.zh-TW: 支援管理 Git 工作樹，平行開發多分支
title.en: Support for Managing Git Worktrees to Develop Multiple Branches in Parallel

body.zh-TW: 當你想在同一個專案同時開發不同功能，又不想頻繁切換分支打斷進度時，現在可以在受信任的本機專案中使用專屬工具。只要開啟工作樹功能，AI 就能直接建立並列出託管的 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。⟦好比在圖畫紙旁多鋪一張描圖紙，以前想畫草稿必須擦掉原本的線條，現在能同時畫兩張草圖而且隨時對照。⟧
body.en: When you want to develop different features in the same project simultaneously without interrupting progress by frequently switching branches, dedicated tools are now available in trusted local projects. Once the worktree feature is enabled, the AI can directly create and list managed Git worktrees (parallel copies of the same project managed by Git). ⟦Picture laying an extra sheet of tracing paper beside your drawing paper: whereas sketching a new idea previously meant erasing original lines, you can now work on two drafts simultaneously and cross-reference them at any time.⟧

items.original: Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled. (#50148)

title.zh-TW: 按鍵釘選重要任務，集中在置頂群組
title.en: Pin Important Tasks via Keystroke to Group Them at the Top

body.zh-TW: 當你在代理人的命令中心同時追蹤好幾個任務，想把當前最重要的項目固定在顯眼處時，現在只要按下鍵盤上的 p 鍵就能快速釘選。只要伺服器支援這項功能，被釘選的任務就會統一歸入共用的 Pinned 群組中，方便你隨時回頭檢視這些項目的處理進度。⟦像在辦公白板上貼便利貼，以前待辦項目一多很容易被新任務洗下去，現在能把要緊的事釘在最上方的專用區域，一眼就能看清。⟧
body.en: When tracking multiple tasks simultaneously in the agent command center and looking to keep the most critical items prominent, you can now press the p key on your keyboard to pin them quickly. As long as the server supports this capability, pinned tasks are consolidated into a shared Pinned group, making it easy to review their progress at any time. ⟦Like placing sticky notes on an office whiteboard, where a growing list of to-dos once got buried under incoming tasks, you can now pin pressing items to a dedicated top section for immediate visibility.⟧

items.original: Pin tasks in the agent Command Center with `p` and keep them in a shared Pinned group when supported by the server. (#51500)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面複製更靈活，滾輪速度隨意調
title.en: Flexible Terminal UI Copying and Adjustable Scroll Speed

body.zh-TW: 在終端介面翻看長篇對話時，如果你想快速抓出某段程式碼或重點回覆，現在的操作方式更加順手。你可以直接輸入 /copy 來選取並複製對話紀錄區塊，或是按下 Ctrl+Insert 複製目前滑鼠反白的文字。如果覺得終端介面捲動太快或太慢，還可以在設定中加入 tui.mouse_scroll_speed 調整滑鼠滾輪的捲動速度。⟦彷彿看長篇電子書時換了順手的翻頁器，以前選字複製經常受限於視窗操作，現在能精準抓取段落還能微調捲動步調。⟧
body.en: When browsing long conversations in the terminal UI, extracting specific code snippets or key responses is now much smoother. You can enter /copy to select and copy conversation blocks, or press Ctrl+Insert to copy text currently highlighted by the mouse. If the terminal UI scrolls too fast or too slow, you can also add tui.mouse_scroll_speed in the settings to adjust the mouse wheel scroll speed. ⟦Think of switching to a handy page-turner while reading a long e-book, where selecting and copying text was once constrained by window interactions, but you can now capture exact passages and fine-tune your scrolling pace.⟧

items.original: Navigate and copy transcript blocks with `/copy`, use `Ctrl+Insert` to copy selections, and tune mouse-wheel scrolling with `tui.mouse_scroll_speed`. (#50434, #50215, #50209)

title.zh-TW: 終端各類提示網址皆可點，跨行連結不中斷
title.en: Clickable Terminal Prompt URLs with Unbroken Multi-Line Links

body.zh-TW: 當 AI 在終端機跳出確認提問或警告訊息並附上參考網址時，你現在不必再手動反白複製。不論網址出現在確認標頭、提問清單、警告橫幅、驗證提示，還是 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）提示中，都能直接點擊開啟。就算網址太長被終端機自動折到下一行，連結依然能完整點開而不會斷成兩截。⟦好似在紙本書的註腳旁附上完整 QR 碼，以前長網址印成兩行容易抄錯，現在直接掃描就能連到正確網頁。⟧
body.en: When the AI displays confirmation questions or warning messages in the terminal with reference URLs, you no longer need to manually highlight and copy them. Whether a URL appears in a confirmation header, question list, warning banner, verification prompt, or an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) prompt, you can click to open it directly. Even if a URL is long and wrapped to the next line by the terminal, the link still opens completely without breaking in two. ⟦A printed book includes a complete QR code next to its footnotes: whereas long URLs split across two lines were once prone to copying errors, scanning directly now opens the exact page.⟧

items.original: Make URLs clickable in approval headers, questions, MCP prompts, warnings, banners, and verification prompts, including when links wrap across lines. (#51439, #51449, #51450, #51451, #51452, #51458)

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型支援聯網搜尋，可開啟遠端壓縮
title.en: Custom Models Gain Web Access and Remote Compaction Support

body.zh-TW: 如果你串接了相容於 Responses 介面的自訂模型供應商，現在能替它們啟用更多進階能力。你可以直接為這些自訂模型設定即時聯網功能（live web access），讓模型取得最新網路資訊。還可設定遠端壓縮能力（remote compaction），讓對話內容的濃縮由遠端處理。⟦如同替外聘的專家助理配置即時百科與秘書，你可以替他配上查詢新資料的工具，也可以安排秘書協助濃縮紀錄。⟧
body.en: If you connect custom model providers compatible with the Responses API, you can now enable more advanced capabilities for them. You can configure live web access directly for these custom models so they can retrieve the latest web information. You can also configure remote compaction so that conversation summaries are processed remotely. ⟦Equipping an external expert assistant with an updated encyclopedia and a secretary allows you to provide tools for looking up fresh data while also assigning a secretary to condense conversation logs.⟧

items.original: Configure live web access and remote compaction capabilities for custom Responses-compatible model providers. (#50459)

title.zh-TW: JavaScript 支援非同步串流，程式模式工具可排序
title.en: JavaScript Async Streaming Support and Ranked Tools in Code Mode

body.zh-TW: 在撰寫自動化腳本或使用程式模式（Code Mode）處理大量工具時，開發體驗得到了進一步強化。這次新增了 JavaScript 輔助工具，能在多個非同步操作（Promise）各自完成時立即串流回傳結果，不必苦等全部做完才一次收到。此外在 Code Mode 中，你還可以主動啟用排序工具搜尋功能，讓系統依照關聯度推薦最合適的工具。⟦跟外送點餐即時收到每道菜出餐通知一樣，以前得等整桌菜炒完才送上來，現在哪道先好就能先拿到並更快找到餐具。⟧
body.en: When writing automation scripts or handling numerous tools in Code Mode, the development experience is further enhanced. New JavaScript helper utilities now stream results back immediately as multiple asynchronous operations (Promise instances) complete individually, without waiting for every task to finish. Furthermore, in Code Mode, you can actively enable ranked tool search so the system recommends the most relevant tools by relevance. ⟦Food delivery orders send real-time alerts as each dish leaves the kitchen: instead of waiting for the entire table of dishes to be cooked before serving, you receive each item as it is ready and locate utensils much faster.⟧

items.original: Add JavaScript helpers for streaming promise results as they settle, plus opt-in ranked tool search in Code Mode. (#51126, #51209)

title.zh-TW: 終端對話遵循預設模型，保留手動指定參數
title.en: Terminal Sessions Follow Default Models While Preserving Manual Overrides

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟新的終端對話時，系統現在會優先採用伺服器端設定的模型與推理摘要預設值。以前新建對話可能忽略伺服器給定的預設配置，現在系統會完整遵循這些預設選項。假使你在啟動時手動傳入了特定參數，系統也會優先保留你明確指定的覆寫值，不會被預設設定強行蓋過。⟦宛若走進連鎖餐廳用餐，以前廚房常搞錯標準配方，現在預設會照標準菜單出餐，但也依然遵循你點單時註明的客製需求。⟧
body.en: When starting a new terminal conversation, the system now prioritizes server-configured defaults for models and reasoning summaries. Whereas creating a new conversation previously could ignore default server settings, the system now adheres fully to these defaults. If you manually pass specific parameters at launch, the system also prioritizes and retains your explicit override values instead of overwriting them with defaults. ⟦Dining at a chain restaurant illustrates the change: while the kitchen previously could mix up standard recipes, it now serves according to the standard menu by default while still honoring any custom preferences specified on your order.⟧

items.original: Respect server model and reasoning-summary defaults for new TUI threads while retaining explicit launch overrides. (#50013, #50811, #50913)

title.zh-TW: 套用補丁保留換行格式，Windows 檔案不跑版
title.en: Patch Application Preserves Line Endings Without Corrupting Windows Files

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下修補程式碼時，你不再需要特地手動指定設定來維持原本的換行格式。以前執行 apply_patch 更新檔案時，若未額外開啟選項，既有的 CRLF（Windows 標準換行符號）可能會被改掉；現在 apply_patch 會自動保留檔案原有的換行格式。這個問題已經修好，能避免檔案送出版控時多出整份換行差異。⟦跟維護舊文件一樣，以前每次送出修訂都得額外勾選保留原本排版，否則換行符號會被洗掉；現在直接套用也能原樣留存。⟧
body.en: When patching code in Windows environments, you no longer need to manually specify settings to preserve original line endings. Previously, updating files with apply_patch could alter existing CRLF line endings (the standard Windows line-ending format) unless an extra option was enabled; apply_patch now automatically preserves the file's original line endings. This issue is resolved, preventing unintended diffs across the entire file when committing changes to version control. ⟦Maintaining legacy documents once required ticking an extra box on every revision to keep original formatting from getting overwritten, but applying edits now preserves line endings automatically.⟧

items.original: Preserve existing CRLF line endings in `apply_patch` updates without requiring an opt-in. (#51203)

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙箱啟動防護強化，嚴格落實檔案隔離
title.en: Enhanced Linux Sandbox Startup Protections and Enforced File Isolation

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 環境中使用安全沙箱隔離執行環境時，系統修復了多項攸關啟動與檔案存取的安全限制。當設定了多個禁止存取的檔案時，沙箱以前可能無法順利啟動，現在啟動流程已修復。沙箱現在會拒絕可被寫入的建構執行檔。也修正了 ripgrep 設定，確保搜尋配置不會削弱禁止規則（deny-glob）的檔案遮罩防護。⟦就像保險庫修好了門禁名單一多就卡住的問題，也拒用能被改動的門禁安裝工具，並讓查找物品的設定不會削弱禁止存取的名單。⟧
body.en: When using the security sandbox to isolate execution environments on Linux, the system fixed several security constraints related to startup and file access. The sandbox previously could fail to start when multiple denied files were configured, but this startup process is now fixed. Sandboxes now reject writable executables used to construct the sandbox. The ripgrep configuration was also corrected to ensure search settings do not weaken deny-glob file mask protections. ⟦A bank vault fixes a stall that occurred whenever access denial lists grew too long, rejects modifiable installation tools, and ensures search settings never undermine restricted lists.⟧

items.original: Fix Linux sandbox startup with multiple denied files, reject writable sandbox-construction executables, and keep ripgrep configuration from weakening deny-glob masks. (#50059, #51211, #51407, #51527)

title.zh-TW: Windows 10 磁碟存取恢復，沙箱暫存權限一致
title.en: Restored Windows 10 Drive Access and Consistent Sandbox Temp Permissions

body.zh-TW: 如果你在 Windows 10 系統上執行指令或使用沙箱隔離環境，先前遇到的路徑找不到與權限錯誤已獲得修復。現在恢復了一般磁碟代號（如常見的 C 槽與 D 槽）檔案存取能力，讀寫既有檔案不再出錯。Windows 沙箱內的暫存目錄權限也調整為與子行程（subprocess，由主程式啟動的附屬運作程序）環境一致，避免程式在執行時因權限不符而卡住。⟦有如拿到了相符的門禁卡，以前在 Windows 10 容易讀不到磁碟或被暫存目錄擋在門外，現在權限一致後各項操作都能順利通行。⟧
body.en: If you run commands or use sandboxed environments on Windows 10, previously encountered missing path and permission errors are now resolved. Standard drive letter file access (such as common C: and D: drives) is restored, preventing errors when reading or writing existing files. Permissions for temporary directories inside the Windows sandbox are also aligned with environments of subprocesses (child processes started by the main program), preventing programs from hanging due to permission mismatches during execution. ⟦Obtaining a matching keycard resolves previous hurdles on Windows 10 where drives were unreadable or temp directories locked you out, ensuring all operations proceed smoothly with consistent permissions.⟧

items.original: Restore ordinary drive-letter file access on Windows 10 and match Windows sandbox temp permissions to the child process environment. (#51511, #51512)

title.zh-TW: 遵循伺服器建議時間重試
title.en: Retrying Requests Following Server Recommendations

body.zh-TW: 使用 Codex 時，送出的請求或即時連線若失敗，你可能需要等一段時間才能重試。Responses（傳送模型請求的介面）的可重試失敗，現在會遵循伺服器的 Retry-After 建議。這個標頭會告訴用戶端應等待多久再試。WebSocket（維持雙向即時通訊的連線）的可重試失敗也適用：依照建議時間等待後再重試。⟦好比撥打客服電話遇到忙線，聽到語音建議稍後再撥，就依照建議等候，再重新撥打。⟧
body.en: When using Codex, if a sent request or real-time connection fails, you may need to wait for a while before retrying. Retryable failures for Responses (the interface for sending model requests) now follow the server's Retry-After recommendation. This header tells the client how long to wait before trying again. Retryable failures for WebSocket connections (which maintain two-way, real-time communication) also follow this rule by waiting for the suggested duration before retrying. ⟦When dialing a busy customer service line, a caller follows the automated voice prompt to wait for the suggested time before calling back.⟧

items.original: Honor server `Retry-After` advice for retryable Responses and WebSocket failures. (#50418, #51440)

title.zh-TW: Windows 安裝程式附帶數位簽章，版本下載更安全
title.en: Windows Installers Include Digital Signatures for Safer Version Downloads

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 下安裝或更新系統時，安裝腳本與版本下載機制現在具備更高的安全性與相容性。Windows 發行版本現在附帶已簽署的 PowerShell 安裝程式。當環境中存在 PowerShell 7 模組路徑時，舊版透過 Windows PowerShell 安裝可能發生的壓縮檔校驗碼驗證失敗問題也已修好。下載管理方面，系統現在能防止舊版或預覽版本意外覆蓋較新的穩定版下載目標與安裝別名。⟦猶如官方包裹附上可核對來源的簽名，以前可能誤把舊包裹拿來替換新品，現在不會了。⟧
body.en: When installing or updating the system on Windows, installer scripts and version download mechanisms now offer higher security and compatibility. Windows releases now include a signed PowerShell installer. When PowerShell 7 module paths exist in the environment, archive checksum verification failures that previously occurred when installing through Windows PowerShell are now fixed. For download management, the system now prevents older or preview versions from accidentally overwriting newer stable download targets and installation aliases. ⟦Receiving an official package with a verifiable signature ensures that old parcels are no longer mistakenly used to replace brand-new items.⟧

items.original:
Fix archive checksum verification when installing through Windows PowerShell with PowerShell 7 module paths present. (#51257)
Publish a signed PowerShell installer with Windows releases. (#51158)
Keep older stable releases and prereleases from replacing newer stable download targets or installer aliases. (#51186, #51425)
